```{r}
library(tidyverse)
pg_populations <- read_csv("~/Documents/GitHub/jour_405/Incorporated cities populations - Sheet1.csv")

pg_populations |> summarize(
  mean = mean(`Population 2025`, na.rm = TRUE),
  sd = sd(`Population 2025`, na.rm = TRUE)
  median = median(`Population 2025`, na.rm = TRUE)
)


```

```{r}
pg_populations |> 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_histogram(aes(x = `Population 2025`))
```
